observed: dynamic-decomposition v0.9 builds conflict signatures from classification plus canonical provenance, so two unique GUT receipts with the same contamination classification but different provenance are forced into HOLD.
risk: Source difference is incorrectly treated as diagnostic disagreement. This creates false uncertainty, blocks a valid bounded decomposition profile, and can make cross-organ regulation appear more cautious while actually discarding agreement information.
requiredFix: Conflict must be driven by incompatible triage classifications, not provenance inequality alone. Distinct provenance must remain fully audited and must never be promoted as proof of source independence.
requiredTests: different classification + distinct provenance => HOLD with zero facets
arrival order does not alter behavior
distinct provenance remains visible in provenance audit
existing replay suppression and GUT echo-break regression remain intact
promotionRule: Do not change public status until focused CI and NOSTROMO integration both pass.
